# Cncf Grafana Loki Reviewer

Review Grafana Loki using its official documentation and repository in the Observability and Analysis / Observability category. Loki is a horizontally-scalable, highly-available, multi-tenant log aggregation system inspired by Prometheus. It is designed to be very cost effective and easy to operate. It does not index the contents of the logs, but rather a set of labels for each log stream.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
